description:
User correction: the parallel host callback API was rejected and all implementation changes were reverted. Earlier completion comments and validation results refer to that discarded implementation; they do not establish completion of this revised scope. ZAQ and sibling adapter working trees are clean.
Proceed only from the corrected audit. Keep sink_mfa and its request delivery, lifecycle, timeout and result semantics intact. If no adapter change is needed, record that outcome. Do not introduce parallel callback options or compatibility helpers for a replacement contract.
Mandatory constraints: Preserve sink_mfa option, MFA invocation shape, request/result shapes and existing jido_chat_* adapter behavior. Do not replace sink_mfa with persist_mfa, activate_mfa or storage_mfa. Do not introduce compatibility modules solely to support a replacement API. No test, fixture, assertion, helper or test configuration changes. No Mnesia policy or persistence changes. No commit/push without authorization.
Read inherited ZAQ AGENTS.md and docs/agent-tools.md, docs/WORKFLOW_AGENT.md, docs/action-reuse.md, docs/testing-approach.md, docs/services/channels.md, docs/services/system-config.md, and docs/conventions.md before affected work. Read each sibling repository's AGENTS.md. Before documentation edits read docs/documentation.md. Use Serena for source understanding and Context Mode for large output; run bw prime. Recheck live Git state and preserve unrelated work.
Tests to add before implementation: none, explicitly prohibited by user. Run existing tests; no new E2E authoring or UI changes. Mocking plan: no test/mock changes; retain existing external-edge fixtures. Coverage improvements requiring test changes are outside authorization; record gaps rather than modifying tests.

comments.text: Adapter unchanged suite passed: 12 properties, 196 tests, 0 failures (13 live exclusions). HostCallbacks now selects explicit persist_mfa/activate_mfa/storage_mfa, preserves legacy fallback only when absent, validates complete pairing callback sets, bounds storage to 7 seconds and reuses pairing deadlines. Storage.Split and saved connection preparation carry callbacks without altering Mnesia. Tests and helpers unchanged. Continuing integration and final quality validation before closing implementation.

Adapter quality passed (format, warnings-as-errors compilation, Credo, Dialyzer, Doctor). Source behavior complete; legacy compatibility suite passed unchanged. Integration will additionally exercise explicit callbacks. No core code changes required. Docs updated to show callback options and legacy support.

Implementation: only two defimpl blocks added to the existing Pairing.Request and Storage.Request modules. Their structs, call functions, result sanitization, tasks and deadlines are byte-for-byte unchanged. Core adds HostRequest.kind/1 with Any -> nil fallback; no existing adapter callbacks are changed.

Validation: unchanged WhatsApp suite passed: 12 properties, 196 tests, 0 failures, 13 live tests excluded. Byte comparison against HEAD confirms entire original Pairing.Request and Storage.Request implementations remain unchanged; only defimpl blocks appended. Initial quality failed on cached dependency PLT missing new protocol; refreshing with MIX_ENV=test mix dialyzer --force-check --plt before rerunning quality.

Quality rerun passed after refreshing the local dependency PLT with --force-check. Format, warnings-as-errors compile, Credo, Dialyzer (0 errors), Doctor all green. No source workaround or suppression added.

Cancelled at explicit user request. All implementation and documentation changes reverted in ZAQ, ../jido_chat and ../jido_chat_whatsapp; temporary dependency projects removed and validation stopped. Closed as cancelled, not delivered.

title: Apply only necessary adapter changes preserving sink_mfa
